# Technology for Commissioners

**Technology** **tools** are available to help commissioners provide valuable
**Unit Service** leading to improved **Unit Health** that results in continual
**Youth and Unit Retention**.

[ ![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/SoCI-IMG.png)
](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/SoCI-IMG.png)

### Suite of Commissioner Information/Technology Tools

  * **[Commissioner Tools](https://www.scouting.org/commissioners/suite-of-commissioner-information-technology-tools/)**
    * Unit Dashboard
    * Commissioner Assignments
    * Simple/Detailed Assessments
    * Priority Needs status
    * Unit Service Plan
    * Charter Renewal Status
    * Roundtable Planning/Attendance
  * [**Roster**](https://www.scouting.org/commissioners/suite-of-commissioner-information-technology-tools/#SCIRoster)
    * Leader contact information
    * Merit badge counselor listing
    * Advancement reports
    * Unit Pin details
  * [**Training Manager**](https://www.scouting.org/commissioners/suite-of-commissioner-information-technology-tools/#SCITrainingMngr)
    * YPT training details
    * Adult and Youth Training details
  * **Quick & Easy Reference Guides**
    * [Unit Commissioners](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/Commissioner-Tool-Reference-Document-UC.pdf)
    * [Administrative Commissioners](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/Commissioner-Tool-Reference-Document-Admin-1.pdf)
    * [Roundtable Commissioners](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/Commissioner-Tool-Reference-Document-RT-1.pdf)
    * [General information for all Commissioners](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/Commissioner-Tool-Reference-Document-General.pdf)

[ ![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2020/06/Roundtable-
Formats.png)![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-
content/uploads/2020/06/Roundtable-Formats.png) ](https://www.scouting.org/wp-
content/uploads/2020/06/Roundtable-Formats.png)

### Recommended Best Tools To Use

  * [**Unit Commissioners**](https://www.scouting.org/commissioners/suite-of-commissioner-information-technology-tools/#BTTUUnitComm)
    * Unit Dashboard
    * Unit Leaders and Members Roster
    * Collaborative Detailed Assessment
    * Simple Assessments
    * Unit Roster
    * Unit Advancement/Activity/Training
  * [**Roundtable Commissioners**](https://www.scouting.org/commissioners/suite-of-commissioner-information-technology-tools/#BTTURTComm)
    * Planning
    * Meeting Notes
    * Attendance
    * Current Year Summary
  * **[Administrative Commissioners](https://www.scouting.org/commissioners/suite-of-commissioner-information-technology-tools/#BTTUAdminComm)**
    * Council/District Dashboard
    * Commissioner Assignments
    * Number of Unit Commissioners
    * Unit Contacts and Comments
    * Priority Needs
    * Roundtable
  * **How To Use “Best Tools”**
    * Unit Commissioner [PDF](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/Impact-Session-Technology-Needs-for-Unit-Commissioners.pdf)
    * Administrative Commissioner [Video](https://vimeo.com/655712148/8bdd313b3e) | [PDF](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/Impact-Session-Technology-Needs-for-Admnistrative-Commissioners.pdf)
    * Roundtable Commissioner [PDF](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/Impact-Session-Technology-Tools-for-Roundtable-Commissioners.pdf)
